tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the Verateca register by product name, brand, ingredient or barcode. Returns up to 10 matches with IDs, brands, page addresses and recent published prices where available. Use detail "full" for the number of offers and more record details. Results are ordered by match, never by payment. Ref

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one published product by name, ID or page address, or asks which match is meant. The compact answer includes the label composition, applicable reference limits, recent published prices and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for the country status, label verification and detail

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.description: Finds a substance by name, form, synonym or ID. Omega-3 and fish oil identify EPA and DHA separately. Returns forms and the applicable country limit, then other countries’ limits with their scope, sources and recorded dates where available. Use detail "full" for form details, references and a link t

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Adds known amounts from up to 12 entries, which can be published product names or IDs or ingredient amounts supplied by the person. Returns matched products, known daily amounts and applicable published adult reference comparisons. Daily totals need an amount, unit and stated daily use. For entries

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compares 2 to 6 published products by name or ID and asks for clarification when a match is unclear. The compact answer includes daily amounts, rounded prices and applicable comparisons where available. Use detail "full" for the verified pack basis and detailed reference comparisons. The applicable

tools.name: get_selection_link
tools.description: Returns the address of the Verateca order page for one of its three paid services (quick, full, review), with the price and currency the site shows for the country and a one-line description. The tool takes no payment and creates no order; the order page asks its own questions and takes payment ther

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
